note.en: Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散
name.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes

name.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み

note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Scoped executed example: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. Not standard Earth parameters, a full global multidimensional SWE core, exact discrete balance or a PV-conservation claim. Bind the fixed-input formula, reference, figure and executable code. name.ja: この手法の比較・参照資料
name.en: Comparison and reference material for this method

name.ja: WENO-JS／Z：臨界点とεの固定比較
name.en: WENO-JS/Z: fixed critical-point and epsilon comparison

note.ja: 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。
note.en: Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics.

name.ja: ロジスティック増殖：解析解と刻み幅の収束
name.en: Logistic growth: analytic solution and time refinement

note.ja: 無次元の単一個体群。RK4を全出力時刻で解析解と比較し、非負性と刻み幅の収束を確認。反応拡散・複数種は対象外。
note.en: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

name.ja: SIR：独立DOP853参照・人口保存・収束
name.en: SIR: independent DOP853 reference, conservation and convergence

note.ja: 閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。
note.en: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

name.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
name.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

note.ja: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。
note.en: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions.

name.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン
name.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns

note.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
note.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照
name.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference

note.ja: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
note.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

name.ja: 2D C-grid回転浅水波の実時間発展
name.en: Actual2D C-grid rotating shallow-water time advance

note.ja: 実際の2D staggered場を時間積分し、連続波と離散symbolの参照を分けて比較します。
note.en: Time-advance actual2D staggered fields and distinguish continuous-wave references from semidiscrete symbols.

name.ja: 振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化
name.en: Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum

note.ja: 位置拘束の指数3系から明示ODEを導き、整合・非整合初期値の拘束ドリフトと安定化を比較します。
note.en: Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts.

name.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似
name.en: Enzyme conservation and QSSA

note.ja: 全4状態と準定常近似を比較し、初期層と積分誤差を分けます。
note.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism.

name.ja: Lotka–Volterra不変量と正値性
name.en: Lotka–Volterra invariant and positivity

note.ja: 正の軌道を独立な対数座標参照と比較します。
note.en: Compare a positive orbit against an independently integrated log-coordinate reference.

name.ja: SEIR保存則と初期線形化
name.en: SEIR conservation and initial linearization

note.ja: 人口保存と2モードの初期線形化を別々に検査します。
note.en: Check population conservation and the full two-mode initial linearization separately.

name.ja: Hodgkin–Huxley：電位固定・静止平衡・発火
name.en: Hodgkin–Huxley: clamps, rest and firing

note.ja: 固定電位の解析ゲート解と、区分電流下の4状態系を照合します。
note.en: Compare analytic clamp gates and a four-state system with segment-owned current.

name.ja: 球面浅水波の軸対称定常釣合いを時間積分
name.en: Time evolution of axisymmetric spherical shallow-water balance

note.ja: 球面浅水波の軸対称な無次元定常状態を実際に時間積分し、釣合い残差と格子依存を分ける。
note.en: NondimensionalWilliamson2-type axisymmetricsubproblem. Analyticstaticstatevsactualtimeintegration; not fullglobaldynamicalcore/PVclaim.
